mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_image, c.is_public, c.create_time, c.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , COUNT(ca.article_id) AS article_count FROM collection c LEFT JOIN collection_article ca ON c.id = ca.collection_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collection (name, description, cover_image, is_public, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, #{isPublic}, NOW(), NOW())
